title: The mixed scalar and quotient adjunction mate
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E→L over Q_l, a scheme X, and n≤m. Use the finite coefficient categories and scalar extension/restriction of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], the quotient maps of [def-coef-finite-dualizing-data], and the normalized restrictions of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. The single quotient q_F:A_(F,m+1)→A_(F,n+1) is constant-sheafified with commutativity retained. The coefficient square iota_m;q_L=q_E;iota_n holds on residue representatives. Normalized restriction is derived restriction along q_F. Identity on sections gives an isomorphism R_(iota_n);Res_E≅Res_L;R_(iota_m) by the two canonical composition isomorphisms. Define the mixed map scalarReductionExchange:Res_E;T_(iota_m)→T_(iota_n);Res_L as its inverse mate under the two scalar adjunctions. This is a specified natural transformation; no invertibility is asserted.
